|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Dash In Rogue 10]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-113-Dash_In_Rogue_10-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Dash In Rogue 10]].
* '''Original''' ([[Dash In Rogue 10]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Dash, who provides ability of 3. During battle, if with another T-47 and about to draw a battle destiny, may draw two and choose one. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 52). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Dash In Rogue 10 (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “about to draw battle destiny” for “about to draw a battle destiny”: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Dash, who provides ability of 3. During battle, if with another T-47 and about to draw battle destiny, may draw two and choose one. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="cl-1261_109-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
